usage: The word 古巴 is used as a proper noun to refer specifically to the country of Cuba.
When talking about travel plans, people often mention 古巴 as a destination.
You can use 古巴 in sentences describing nationality or cultural aspects related to Cuba.
It is placed after verbs like 去 (go) when saying you are going to Cuba.
古巴 can also be used in casual conversations about international news or sports involving Cuba.
